metadata.title: Plasma membrane-localized hexose transporter OsSWEET1b, afects sugar metabolism and leaf senescence

entities.name: OsSWEET1b
entities.description: Rice SWEET gene characterized as a hexose transporter; expressed higher in leaves, localized to the plasma membrane, and functionally active in yeast for glucose and galactose transport.

entities.name: OsSWEET1b protein
entities.description: Protein product of OsSWEET1b; shown to localize to the plasma membrane, transport glucose and galactose in yeast, and form homodimers.

entities.name: reduced sugar content in leaves
synonyms: reduced sucrose, glucose, fructose, starch and galactose contents
entities.description: Leaf sugar contents were reduced in ossweet1b mutants during grain filling.

entities.name: premature leaf senescence phenotype
entities.description: ossweet1b knockout plants showed premature senescence of leaves at the grain-filling stage.

entities.name: reduced photosynthetic capacity
entities.description: ossweet1b mutants had decreased chlorophyll and photosynthetic parameters, with disordered chloroplast structure.

entities.name: reduced rice yield
entities.description: ossweet1b mutants had lower seed setting rate, 1000-grain weight and yield per plant.

entities.name: carbon starvation in leaves
entities.description: Knockout of OsSWEET1b caused reduced leaf sugar content and induced carbon starvation-related gene expression.

relations.mechanism: Loss of OsSWEET1b function reduced sucrose, glucose, fructose, starch and galactose contents in leaves during grain filling.
relations.evidence: ossweet1b mutants were have reduced the sucrose, glucose, fructose, starch and galactose contents

relations.mechanism: Knockout of OsSWEET1b led to leaf yellowing and premature senescence at the filling stage.
relations.evidence: ossweet1b-1 and ossweet1b-2 mutant exhibited premature senescence phenotype, with their leaves turning yellow while the WT leaves remained green

relations.mechanism: Mutation of OsSWEET1b decreased chlorophyll content, Fv/Fm, stomatal conductance and net photosynthetic rate, and disrupted chloroplast structure.
relations.evidence: The chlorophyll a (Chla) and chlorophyll b (Chlb) content of ossweet1b mutants were obviously decrease than WT... the values of Fv/Fm, stomatal conductance (Gs) and net photosynthetic rate (Pn) were markedly reduced

relations.mechanism: OsSWEET1b knockout reduced effective tillers, seed setting rate, 1000-grain weight and yield per plant.
relations.quantitative_effect: seed setting rate was about 90% in the WT, but only 58% and 56% in the ossweet1b-1 and ossweet1b-2 mutants; 1000-grain weight was about 24 g in WT, but approximately 20 g in the mutants; yield per plant decreased 64% and 65%
relations.evidence: The seed setting rate was about 90% in the WT, but only 58% and 56% in the ossweet1b-1 and ossweet1b-2 mutants, respectively... The 1000-grain weight was about 24 g in WT, but approximately 20 g in the ossweet1b-1 and ossweet1b-2 mutants... the ossweet1b-1 and ossweet1b-2 mutants showed decrease 64% and 65% in yield per plant

relations.mechanism: OsSWEET1b mutation reduced sugar content and induced carbon starvation-related gene expression, including DIN homologs.
relations.evidence: the OsSWEET1b gene may be a positive regulator of sugar content in leaves and its knockout caused reduced sugar content and carbon starvation in leaves
